mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing apparatus to the lungs and circulation was most worthwhile because it linked the assembled parts to a clear explanation of airflow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first two constructions felt repetitive: their pictures showed parts being assembled but did not yet explain how they moved the lungs.

surprise.text: The explanation that chemical feedback helps adjust breathing added a useful dimension to the control pathway.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several were predictable, and the menu supplied their compatibility.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final connection between breathing and circulation made me curious how the remaining body systems fit together.
